mapper.delete: delete from apply_record where apply_record.student_id = #{Stu_id} and apply_record.id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into apply_record (student_id,module, title, category, description, score, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{stuid},#{a.module},#{a.title},#{a.category},#{a.description},#{a.score},"待审核",now(),now())
mapper.update:
update apply_record
title = #{a.title},
category = #{a.category},
description = #{a.description},
score = #{a.score},
status = #{a.status},
update_time = now()
where id = #{a.id}

UPDATE scoring_module sm JOIN ( SELECT student_id, module, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM apply_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = '已通过' GROUP BY student_id, module ) ar ON sm.student_id = ar.student_id AND sm.module = ar.module SET sm.score = ar.total_score, sm.update_time = NOW() WHERE sm.student_id = #{studentId};
